root.description: The id of the root the path is under

path.description: The package.json holding the script, relative to its root

script.description: The script's name (its last occurrence when the key repeats)

segment.description: 0-based position of the compiling segment among the script's segments, split on `&&`, `||` and `;`

ordinal.description: 0-based position among the projects the segment names: 0 for a `-p` or default project, each build-mode positional in order

package.description: The package.json `name`, or null when absent or not a string

packageDir.description: The package's directory, relative to its root; `.` for the root package

compiler.description: The compiler token's basename, as written

project.description: The project as named, normalised and relative to the root: `-p`/`--project` value, a build-mode positional, or the package's `tsconfig.json` by default. A path starting `..` leaves the root

config.description: The tsconfig file the project names, relative to its root (a directory resolves to its `tsconfig.json`); null when the file is not git content (TSCONFIG_INVOKED_MISSING) or the project leaves the root

buildMode.description: Whether the segment ran the compiler in build mode (`-b`, `--build`)

line.description: The 1-based line of the script's value in the package.json

projection-tsconfig-invocations.description: A row of the derived `tsconfig_invocations` relation
